observations: Photo 0 shows a Yamaha-branded electronic keyboard with full-size keys and a central control panel; screen/LED area is visible but not readable.

claims.evidence: Photos show a Yamaha keyboard but the exact model/series (which determines “professional”) is not readable.
No video/test showing keys, speakers, and buttons responding; photos only.
No adapter/charger is shown in the photos.
No receipt, serial/UK import label, or documentation shown.
No audio/video test to confirm dead keys or crackling.

risks.risk: Exact Yamaha model is unknown, so the correct market price cannot be confirmed from photos.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the model name/number label (usually on the back/bottom) and the full front panel model text if present.
risks.if_unproven: Price it at the worst-case for an unidentified Yamaha keyboard (assume mid/entry model value rather than a higher-end “professional” unit).

risks.risk: Functionality risk: dead keys, stuck buttons, or intermittent sound/crackling may exist even if the keyboard looks fine.
risks.proof: Short video showing: power on, screen/menus working, playing across the full keyboard range, and pressing multiple buttons/controls; include a quick audio recording of sustained notes.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully proven (worst case: treat as needing service/possible faults).

risks.risk: Power/adapter mismatch: UK purchase may mean different plug/voltage requirements; adapter may be missing or incorrect.
risks.proof: Photo of the exact adapter/charger included (label with voltage/output) and a video of the keyboard powering on using it.
risks.if_unproven: Price as adapter not guaranteed (worst case: buyer must source a correct adapter).

risks.risk: Cosmetic/structural damage not visible in these angles (cracks, loose knobs, damaged speaker area).
risks.proof: Photos of the back panel, bottom, and close-ups of knobs/buttons and speaker grilles; plus a photo showing any serial label.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming possible cosmetic wear consistent with used gear.

proof_requests: Clear photo of the model/serial label (back or bottom) so the exact Yamaha model can be identified.
Video test: power on + screen/menu + play all keys (left to right) + press key buttons/controls; include audio to check for crackle.
Photo of the adapter/charger included (show label specs) and a video of powering on with it.
response.reason: The photos confirm it’s a Yamaha keyboard, but the exact model is not readable and there’s no proof of full functionality or adapter inclusion—both are decisive for pricing and risk in Abuja.
